Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect require you to return three cards to the bottom of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I only return one card to the bottom of the deck from the trash with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't be activated. When a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves its current area while activation is pending, the effect can no longer be activated. In this case, the deleted card's [On Deletion] effect triggers, but it's removed from the trash before the effect can activate.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to delete an opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect, and I used the part of the effect after "then" to return that card from their trash to the bottom of the deck. Can that deleted card's [On Deletion] effect activate at such times?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can choose your trash and your opponent's.Additionally, you can choose any combination of three cards from both trashes, for example, one card from your own trash and two cards from your opponent's trash.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect allow me to choose my trash and my opponent's trash?

Card Q&A.a: The player who activated this card's effect. Which cards and what order to return them in are both specified by the player who activated this effect, then they are returned to the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses the cards that are to be returned to the deck from my opponent’s trash by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
